title: [Perf][MRV2] Reduce cross-lane reductions in min-p filtering
body:
## Overview

Reduce MRV2 min-p scan overhead by accumulating per-lane maxima and reducing across lanes once after the vocabulary scan. Use an 8192-element tile with 16 warps for vocabularies above 16384 and batches up to 32, retaining 1024/4 otherwise.

## Claims

- Preserve one kernel launch, the log-space threshold, request mapping, and int64 row addressing, without a temporary tensor.
- Reduce min-p kernel latency for the measured large-vocabulary batches up to 32 on A100 and RTX 2080 Ti; fixed-parameter comparisons show an independent benefit from per-lane accumulation at small batches.
- Reduce elapsed time for the constructed Qwen3-0.6B application on A100 by 2.72% (batch 8) and 2.43% (batch 32) relative to upstream, with identical outputs in all measured runs.

## Validation

Reproduction commands in a checkout of this PR:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_min_p.py -q
.venv/bin/python benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_min_p.py --batch-sizes 1 8 9 32 33 128 512 --vocab-sizes 32000 128256 151936 --dtype float32
.venv/bin/python benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_min_p.py --batch-sizes 1 8 32 --dtype float16
.venv/bin/python benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_min_p.py --batch-sizes 1 8 32 --dtype bfloat16
.venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run --files vllm/v1/worker/gpu/sample/min_p.py tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_min_p.py benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_min_p.py
```

- 41 GPU cases passed on A100 and RTX 2080 Ti using frozen copies of the candidate module and test file against the source base listed below. Each GPU also passed 90 additional cases per variant across four implementations (360 runs), covering offset views, row padding, FP32/FP16/BF16, repeated request mappings, zero/one/tiny min-p, nonfinite logits, and dispatch boundaries. The existing tests include graph replay with changed parameters.
- Four model variants matched output tokens, processed logprobs, prefix-cache hits, and free-block counts through cold/warm cache, mixed min-p requests, cancellation/reuse, and cache reset/recomputation on A100.
- Applicable pre-commit checks passed, including mypy and test tethering. Upstream Buildkite execution still requires repository CI authorization.

Representative **warm-graph kernel timings**, FP32, vocabulary 151936, µs/call. Four variants run in one process on identical inputs; values are medians of seven shuffled rounds, each averaging 128 launches. The public benchmark above uses Triton's default graph timing to reproduce the kernel comparison; the shuffled comparison also retains each round.

| GPU | Batch | Upstream | Previous PR (`41a45524`) | Parameter-only 16384/16 | Updated PR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A100 80GB PCIe | 1 | 101.51 | 37.79 | 33.61 | 28.49 |
| A100 80GB PCIe | 8 | 104.34 | 38.61 | 34.02 | 28.94 |
| A100 80GB PCIe | 32 | 108.36 | 70.61 | 35.79 | 30.48 |
| RTX 2080 Ti | 1 | 88.87 | 33.28 | 35.82 | 27.30 |
| RTX 2080 Ti | 8 | 91.76 | 34.85 | 38.42 | 28.18 |
| RTX 2080 Ti | 32 | 164.66 | 120.66 | 113.75 | 111.58 |

Complete application on A100: 128 short stories, each generated through outline, draft and edit, followed by local JSON persistence. Qwen3-0.6B revision `c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca`, FP16 model/FP32 sampler logits, TP1, seed 0, temperature .8, top-p 1, top-k -1, MRV2 async scheduling and CUDA graphs. Timing includes prompt construction, tokenization, generation, detokenization, GC and local-disk fsync; engine initialization and warmup are excluded. Prefix caching is disabled. Four variants run in one resident engine, with rotated and reversed ordering.

Elapsed-time medians (seconds); the percentages below are medians of paired reductions across the stated rounds.

| Batch | min-p | Rounds | Upstream | Previous PR | Parameter-only | Updated PR | Calls/task |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 8 | 0.05 | 8 | 13.11622 | 12.81273 | 12.76960 | 12.75783 | 4853 |
| 32 | 0.05 | 8 | 4.43105 | 4.37001 | 4.32613 | 4.32340 | 1355 |
| 8 | 0.0 | 4 | 12.63554 | 12.64321 | 12.63245 | 12.63437 | 0 |
| 32 | 0.0 | 4 | 4.42274 | 4.43209 | 4.43229 | 4.42772 | 0 |

Batch 8, min-p=.05: 2.72% less time than upstream (eight paired reductions: 2.70–2.84%), and 0.43% less than the previous PR (0.37–0.55%). Each task produced 28944 tokens; all 384 stage outputs matched and stopped normally.

Batch 32, min-p=.05: 2.43% less time than upstream (eight paired reductions: 2.31–2.55%), and 1.04% less than the previous PR (0.98–1.19%). Each task produced 28710 tokens; all 384 stage outputs matched and stopped normally.

The min-p=0 controls execute zero filter calls. These are constructed workloads; the reproduction script and individual timings are below.


## Details

This changes `vllm/v1/worker/gpu/sample/min_p.py`. It is distinct from #46539's log-space change in the older runner's logits processor. Current MRV2 sampling PRs and actual module diffs were checked, including #54332, #60566, and #45288; none implements this reduction or launch update.

The filter runs on steps using nonzero min-p. Default `min_p=0` bypasses it. The constructed application uses Qwen3-0.6B with min-p explicitly enabled to exercise this path; Qwen's default recommendation remains min-p=0.

Thanks to @kerry0520 for the [independent measurements and launch-configuration suggestions](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58907#issuecomment-6246069554) that informed this update, including the batch > 8 observation. This PR combines the original per-lane reduction with the launch tuning, correctness tests, and cross-GPU/model validation.

<details>
<summary>Launch configuration and measurement scope</summary>

At the same 8192/16 launch configuration, FP32 vocabulary 151936 and batch 8, per-tile versus per-lane reduction took 36.59 versus 29.06 µs on A100 and 35.88 versus 28.19 µs on RTX 2080 Ti. The launch update improved all 45 measured batch≤32 shapes on each GPU (three dtypes, three vocabularies, and batches 1/8/9/16/32) relative to `41a45524`.

Measurements across batch sizes and cache conditions follow. Each cell is **warm-graph / cold-L2 µs**, FP32, vocabulary 151936. Cold-L2 measurements use CUDA events with rotating buffers and CUDA graphs (FlashInfer's fallback when its CUPTI Python package is unavailable). The launch update applies through batch 32; larger batches retain 1024/4.

| GPU | Batch | Upstream | Previous PR | Parameter-only 16384/16 | Updated PR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A100 | 1 | 101.51 / 101.68 | 37.79 / 38.09 | 33.61 / 33.79 | 28.49 / 28.77 |
| A100 | 8 | 104.34 / 154.01 | 38.61 / 70.14 | 34.02 / 39.12 | 28.94 / 45.36 |
| A100 | 32 | 108.36 / 167.42 | 70.61 / 129.95 | 35.79 / 44.85 | 30.48 / 52.02 |
| A100 | 128 | 257.99 / 258.97 | 226.24 / 226.66 | 157.84 / 158.87 | 224.57 / 226.25 |
| A100 | 512 | 609.64 / 609.13 | 604.70 / 604.88 | 581.46 / 581.79 | 608.71 / 608.51 |
| RTX 2080 Ti | 1 | 88.87 / 109.36 | 33.28 / 44.86 | 35.82 / 37.78 | 27.30 / 28.67 |
| RTX 2080 Ti | 8 | 91.76 / 125.47 | 34.85 / 53.86 | 38.42 / 41.45 | 28.18 / 32.97 |
| RTX 2080 Ti | 32 | 164.66 / 164.15 | 120.66 / 120.22 | 113.75 / 112.44 | 111.58 / 111.16 |
| RTX 2080 Ti | 128 | 432.90 / 432.74 | 431.97 / 431.63 | 446.30 / 446.27 | 431.60 / 431.43 |
| RTX 2080 Ti | 512 | 1817.17 / 1818.54 | 1827.23 / 1826.84 | 1759.92 / 1759.74 | 1823.78 / 1824.03 |

Python source base: `24c9772`; reused precompiled CUDA extensions: `a4eb3f25`; PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130; Triton 3.7.1. This was not a fresh build of all main-branch extensions. The MRV2 sampler converts model logits to FP32 before min-p; FP16/BF16 kernel tests provide additional coverage. Model runs use `VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0`.

Lifecycle checks do not cover every memory-pressure preemption mode. ROCm/XPU, multi-GPU execution, broad model-quality benchmarks and HTTP serving were not tested. Performance percentages apply to the stated workloads and hardware.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Earlier measurements at 41a45524 (September 27)</summary>

These previously published results apply to the earlier B≤8 / four-warp revision.


- 39 GPU tests passed on RTX 5090, 3090 and 4090. Coverage includes dtype/stride boundaries, repeated request mappings, min-p 0/1, nonfinite logits, batch dispatch boundaries and graph replay with changed parameters. Applicable pre-commit checks passed.
- Corresponding model outputs matched exactly. Lifecycle checks also matched processed logprobs, cache hits and free blocks across cold/warm cache, mixed min-p requests, cancellation followed by reuse, and cache reset followed by recomputation. These do not cover every memory-pressure preemption mode.

Representative kernel latency, FP32, vocabulary 151936, GPU-resident parameters:

| GPU | Batch | Before (µs) | After (µs) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| RTX 5090 | 1 | 70.54 | 27.86 |
| RTX 5090 | 8 | 72.64 | 32.15 |
| RTX 5090 | 32 | 72.77 | 53.21 |
| RTX 3090 | 1 | 84.56 | 32.35 |
| RTX 3090 | 8 | 85.24 | 32.76 |
| RTX 3090 | 32 | 152.17 | 104.41 |

Complete workloads on a resident engine (elapsed-time medians):

| Workload | Before (s) | After (s) | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 5090, batch 8, 128 synthetic input tokens / 512 output tokens, min-p=.1 | 1.0398 | 1.0181 | -2.08% |
| Same configuration, min-p=0 control | 1.0023 | 1.0025 | +0.02% |
| 3090, constructed short-story generation/editing task, min-p=.05 | 15.3559 | 15.1044 | -1.64% |
| Same task structure, min-p=0 control | 15.1386 | 15.1532 | +0.10% |

The 3090 task generates 128 short stories in groups of eight, each with an outline, a draft using that outline, and an edit using that draft, then saves JSON with fsync. All 384 stage outputs stopped normally and matched between variants. It produced 28677 tokens and called min-p 4842 times per task, without multiplying by batch size. All six pairs improved by 1.59–1.70%; the control used four pairs. Timing includes prompt construction, tokenization, generation, detokenization and local-disk persistence, with GC enabled; initialization and warmup are excluded. This is a constructed workload, not production traffic. Qwen recommends min-p=0; the nonzero settings deliberately test this optional path.

<details>
<summary>Additional results and measurement limits</summary>

The 5090 synthetic workload ignores EOS to fix output length. Its batch-8 result improved in six of six pairs in each of two runs; the table shows the final run. Natural-text application requests keep EOS enabled, with outline/draft/edit caps of 192/512/512 tokens and thinking disabled.

Small-batch synthetic model timings were noisy: batch 1 changed by +8.13% in the first run and -7.97% in the final run; batch 2's first run was +0.61%. No stable end-to-end speedup is claimed for these cases. Batch 32's final -0.78% was close to control variation. GC was measured and included; it did not explain the earlier variation.

Batch-512 kernel timings on the 3090 were 234.84→235.26 µs at vocabulary 32000, 980.53→970.56 at 128256, and 1117.07→1110.67 at 151936: approximately neutral to slightly faster.

Python sources: `24c9772`; reused precompiled CUDA extensions: `a4eb3f25`; PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130; Triton 3.7.1. This was not a fresh build of all main-branch extensions. The application comparison uses `VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0` for both variants after an earlier 3090 harness failed on an unsupported nvcc `--compress-mode=size` option.

The current validator rejects ordinary positive min-p with speculative decoding. ROCm/XPU, multi-GPU execution, broad model-quality benchmarks and HTTP serving were not tested. These results do not establish the same percentage improvement on other models or workloads.

</details>

AI assistance was used for investigation, implementation and validation with OpenAI Codex. I reviewed every changed line and personally reran the 39 GPU tests (39 passed).



</details>

<details>
<summary>Reproduce the four-variant application comparison</summary>

Use the cached model revision above and local disk for `--artifact-dir`. Save the Python block as `workflow_fourway.py` in a directory containing the four frozen functions. The script is the one used for these measurements; the source base was `24c9772d19251dbbf70fef75119546827c540c63`.

```bash
git show 24c9772d19251dbbf70fef75119546827c540c63:vllm/v1/worker/gpu/sample/min_p.py > baseline_min_p.py
git show 41a45524ef9f67ea562863f1a9de5e5729607305:vllm/v1/worker/gpu/sample/min_p.py > current_min_p.py
cp vllm/v1/worker/gpu/sample/min_p.py patched_min_p.py
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
source = Path('baseline_min_p.py').read_text()
source = source.replace('BLOCK_SIZE = 1024', 'BLOCK_SIZE = 16384')
source = source.replace('        BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE,', '        BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE,\n        num_warps=16,')
Path('knob_min_p.py').write_text(source)
PY
VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 .venv/bin/python workflow_fourway.py \
  --model /path/to/cached/Qwen3-0.6B \
  --output /path/to/results --artifact-dir /path/to/local-output
```

```python
"""Constructed application: briefs -> outlines -> stories -> edited deliverable.

Compare the frozen min-p implementations on identical complete tasks. All text
processing, generation, serialization and output-file fsync are in task time.
Model construction/warmup and output-equality checks are outside task time.
"""
import argparse
import gc
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

os.environ['VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING'] = '0'
os.environ['VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER'] = '1'
os.environ['HF_HUB_OFFLINE'] = '1'
os.environ['TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE'] = '1'
os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'

import torch
from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
import vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.states as states

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--model', required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', required=True)
parser.add_argument('--artifact-dir', required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
root = Path(args.output)
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
artifact_root = Path(args.artifact_dir)
artifact_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
briefs = [
    'A retired lighthouse keeper finds a letter inside a clock that stopped thirty years ago.',
    'A city gardener discovers that an abandoned train platform blooms only at midnight.',
    'A young baker must deliver a birthday cake to someone who has forgotten their own birthday.',
    'Two neighbors who have never spoken exchange messages through a misplaced library book.',
    'A village repairs its old wooden bridge and finds a time capsule from an unknown child.',
    'A traveling musician misses the last ferry and performs for the people waiting on the shore.',
    'An apprentice mapmaker notices that the smallest street on every map has disappeared.',
    'A shop owner lends umbrellas without asking for names and receives an unexpected thank-you.',
]
settings = ['a mountain village', 'a rainy coastal town', 'a busy railway district',
            'a quiet university town', 'a desert settlement', 'a snowy northern port',
            'a riverside neighborhood', 'a remote island', 'an old industrial town',
            'a small farming community', 'a crowded capital', 'a lakeside holiday town',
            'a forest settlement', 'a hillside suburb', 'a historic market town',
            'a windswept fishing village']
variants = {}
hashes = {}
for name in ('baseline', 'current', 'knob', 'patched'):
    path = Path(name + '_min_p.py')
    hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('workflow_' + name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    variants[name] = module.apply_min_p

start_init = time.perf_counter()
llm = LLM(model=args.model, dtype='half', max_model_len=2048,
          max_num_seqs=32, max_num_batched_tokens=2048,
          gpu_memory_utilization=0.45, enable_prefix_caching=False,
          seed=0, async_scheduling=True, disable_log_stats=True,
          compilation_config={'cudagraph_capture_sizes': [1, 8, 32]})
init_seconds = time.perf_counter() - start_init
gc_durations = []
gc_start = None


def observe_gc(phase, info):
    global gc_start
    if phase == 'start':
        gc_start = time.perf_counter()
    elif gc_start is not None:
        gc_durations.append(time.perf_counter() - gc_start)


gc.callbacks.append(observe_gc)
records = []
metadata = dict(
    scenario='constructed 128 short stories, groups of 8 or 32; not production traffic',
    model=args.model, gpu=torch.cuda.get_device_name(), torch=torch.__version__,
    source_sha256=hashes, seed=0, torch_threads=torch.get_num_threads(),
    flashinfer_sampler=os.environ.get('VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER', 'auto'),
    engine_init_seconds=init_seconds, prefix_caching=False,
    temperature=0.8, top_p=1.0, top_k=-1, enable_thinking=False,
    stage_max_tokens=[192, 512, 512], ignore_eos=False,
    timing='warm engine; prompt construction through local-disk output JSON fsync; GC enabled',
    matrix=[dict(batch=8, min_p=.05, pairs=8),
            dict(batch=32, min_p=.05, pairs=8),
            dict(batch=8, min_p=0., pairs=4),
            dict(batch=32, min_p=0., pairs=4)],
    briefs=briefs, settings=settings, total_stories=128, artifact_dir=str(artifact_root),
)


def save_progress():
    (root / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(
        dict(metadata=metadata, records=records), indent=2), encoding='utf-8')


def run_task(variant, batch, min_p, label):
    count = 0

    def counted_filter(*inputs):
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
        return variants[variant](*inputs)

    states.apply_min_p = counted_filter
    gc_durations.clear()
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    start = time.perf_counter()
    stage_outputs = []
    phases = []
    all_briefs = [f'{brief} Set the story in {setting}.'
                  for setting in settings for brief in briefs]
    for start_index in range(0, len(all_briefs), batch):
        group = start_index // batch
        selected = all_briefs[start_index:start_index + batch]
        previous = None
        for stage, limit in zip(('outline', 'draft', 'edit'), (192, 512, 512)):
            stage_start = time.perf_counter()
            calls_before = count
            conversations = []
            for i, brief in enumerate(selected):
                if stage == 'outline':
                    instruction = (
                        f'Plan a short story based on this brief: {brief}\n'
                        'Give exactly four concise plot beats, at most 70 words total. '
                        'Include a clear ending. Return only the outline.')
                elif stage == 'draft':
                    instruction = (
                        f'Brief: {brief}\nOutline:\n{previous[i]}\n'
                        'Write one complete micro-story paragraph. Follow the '
                        'outline, use concrete details, and reach the ending. '
                        'Return only the story, without commentary.')
                else:
                    instruction = (
                        f'Original brief: {brief}\nDraft:\n{previous[i]}\n'
                        'Edit this story for clarity and consistent character names. '
                        'Preserve its events and ending. Return the complete edited '
                        'micro-story as one paragraph, without an explanation.')
                conversations.append([
                    dict(role='system', content='You are a concise fiction writer and editor. Write in English.'),
                    dict(role='user', content=instruction),
                ])
            params = SamplingParams(temperature=.8, top_p=1., top_k=-1,
                                    min_p=min_p, seed=0, max_tokens=limit)
            outputs = llm.chat(conversations, params, use_tqdm=False,
                               chat_template_kwargs={'enable_thinking': False})
            previous = [o.outputs[0].text for o in outputs]
            stage_outputs.append([
                dict(group=group, brief=selected[i], prompt=conversations[i],
                     text=o.outputs[0].text, tokens=list(o.outputs[0].token_ids),
                     prompt_tokens=len(o.prompt_token_ids),
                     finish_reason=o.outputs[0].finish_reason,
                     stop_reason=o.outputs[0].stop_reason)
                for i, o in enumerate(outputs)
            ])
            phases.append(dict(group=group, stage=stage, seconds=time.perf_counter()-stage_start,
                               min_p_calls=count-calls_before,
                               generated_tokens=sum(len(o.outputs[0].token_ids) for o in outputs),
                               input_tokens=sum(len(o.prompt_token_ids) for o in outputs)))
    io_start = time.perf_counter()
    with (artifact_root / f'{label}.json').open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(dict(briefs=briefs, settings=settings, stages=stage_outputs), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    io_seconds = time.perf_counter()-io_start
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    elapsed = time.perf_counter()-start
    measured_gc = sum(gc_durations)
    gc_count = len(gc_durations)
    signature = json.dumps(stage_outputs, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
    row = dict(variant=variant, batch=batch, min_p=min_p, label=label,
               seconds=elapsed, min_p_calls=count, file_write_seconds=io_seconds,
               gc_seconds=measured_gc, gc_count=gc_count, stages=phases,
               generated_tokens=sum(p['generated_tokens'] for p in phases),
               finish_reasons=[r['finish_reason'] for stage in stage_outputs for r in stage],
               output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(signature.encode()).hexdigest())
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
    return row, signature


try:
    for case in metadata['matrix']:
        batch, min_p, pairs = case['batch'], case['min_p'], case['pairs']
        expected = None
        for variant in variants:
            _, signature = run_task(variant, batch, min_p, f'warm-{batch}-{min_p}-{variant}')
            if expected is None:
                expected = signature
            assert signature == expected, ('warmup mismatch', batch, min_p, variant)
        for repeat in range(pairs):
            names = tuple(variants)
            rotated = names[repeat % len(names):] + names[:repeat % len(names)]
            order = rotated if (repeat // len(names)) % 2 == 0 else tuple(reversed(rotated))
            for variant in order:
                row, signature = run_task(variant, batch, min_p,
                                          f'b{batch}-p{min_p}-r{repeat}-{variant}')
                row['repeat'] = repeat
                row['outputs_equal'] = signature == expected
                records.append(row)
                save_progress()
                assert row['outputs_equal'], ('output mismatch', batch, min_p, repeat, variant)
    metadata['completed'] = True
    save_progress()
finally:
    states.apply_min_p = variants['baseline']
    llm.llm_engine.engine_core.shutdown()

```

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>
